row.team_price_text: Pro: $15/mo flat billed yearly ($20 monthly), up to 50 team members
row.evidence: Instatus's pricing page lists "SCIM Directory Sync" only among the Enterprise plan's features (Contact us / Book a demo); SAML SSO starts at Business.
row.notes: Flat per-workspace pricing, not per user: Starter free (5 team members), Pro $15/mo billed yearly or $20 monthly (50 team members; Private Pro $50/mo and Select $100/mo variants are monthly list prices), Business $225/mo yearly or $300 monthly (unlimited team members, SAML SSO), Enterprise custom (SCIM Directory Sync, multiple SSO connections). SAML SSO runs through Instatus's OrbitID identity platform (built on BoxyHQ technology) and supports Okta, Entra/Azure, Google, OneLogin, JumpCloud and others. No public SCIM documentation (endpoints, attributes, deprovisioning) was found in the help centre. The public REST API (all plans, bearer API key) can list, add and delete team members.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $15/mo billed yearly ($20 monthly); Private Pro $50/mo and Select $100/mo variants
plans.notes: Flat price, 50 team members. Variant prices are listed without a yearly figure.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Unlimited team members; admin activity log in-app.

limitations.text: SCIM is listed only for Enterprise; no public SCIM documentation.

scim.notes: Only the pricing page mentions SCIM ('SCIM Directory Sync', Enterprise). No SCIM setup guide, endpoint, attribute or deprovisioning documentation is public.

auth.notes: Per-user API key from User settings > Developer settings.

capabilities.notes: Add takes only an email; the documented request sets no role. Delete removes the member from the page's team.

endpoints.purpose: Add a team member by email

audit_log_api.notes: Admin activity log display is Business+ in the dashboard; no activity-log API endpoint is listed in the API reference.

fallbacks.notes: SSO (SAML, plus OpenID and CAS) via OrbitID with domain verification; whether users are created on first SSO sign-in is not documented.

citations.quote: Get teammates Endpoint: GET /v1/:page_id/team?page = :page & per_page = :per_page The default page number is 1. The default per_page number is 50 and the maximum is 100 items per page.
